Open interpretation questions

Candidate interpretation, not legally reviewed.

  • AE-01

    Scope of public service sites and whether annex language establishes a binding legal obligation need legal review.

    Recorded observation: The annex says public service sites must comply with WCAG 2.1 AA.

    Provision P-01

    Evidence status: Candidate interpretation; Risk: High; Status: Unresolved; Needs: Qualified legal review.

  • AE-02

    Whether separate built-in text-to-speech is mandatory or technology-neutral alternatives satisfy the requirement is not resolved.

    Recorded observation: A text-reader feature is explicitly described.

    Provision P-03

    Evidence status: Candidate interpretation; Risk: High; Status: Unresolved; Needs: Qualified accessibility review.

  • AE-03

    It is unclear which user journeys, media types and service channels require each feature.

    Recorded observation: The annex discusses sign-language and speech recognition features.

    Provision P-03

    Evidence status: Candidate interpretation; Risk: High; Status: Unresolved; Needs: Qualified accessibility review.

  • AE-04

    Whether the 2024 policy is a binding instrument and what enforcement follows a low compliance percentage or complaint is unresolved.

    Recorded observation: The policy defines governance, a Digital Accessibility Officer role, compliance percentages and Digital Government Enablers indicators.

    Provision P-04

    Evidence status: Candidate interpretation; Risk: High; Status: Unresolved; Needs: Qualified legal review.

  • AE-05

    The Arabic policy page and the English policy PDF have not been compared, so authoritative-language status and translation provenance remain unresolved.

    Recorded observation: The Arabic policy page and the English policy PDF are both published by official UAE sources.

    Provision P-05

    Evidence status: Candidate interpretation; Risk: High; Status: Unresolved; Needs: Translation review.
